data.data: Data: research build from RxNorm Current Prescribable 2026-09-08, Drugs@FDA brand names, DDInter bulk download (ddinter2.scbdd.com, 2024-05-21), SIDER 4.1, TWOSIDES (research only; not for redistribution); 635,607 interaction records; not synthetic.

hard_names.rule: name has a comma, a parenthesis or > 30 characters; listed with its 3 most-connected interaction partners
